diagnosis.summary: The nightly run for 2026-10-01 (37ab043d) failed in quality_checks because the upstream orders export for that day also contained the full previous day again: all 461 orders from 2026-09-30, identical to the copies already loaded. raw.orders ended up with 901 rows (195% of normal). That caused 461 duplicate order_ids in stg_orders and left 0 rows for the day in fct_orders. I've proposed asking upstream to re-export orders for 2026-10-01. If the new export still contains the old rows, this goes to the upstream app team.

root_cause.explanation: The 2026-10-01 orders landing file holds 440 new orders plus all 461 orders from 2026-09-30 (old order_ts, identical values) added after them. No order_id repeats within the file; the overlap is with the 09-30 partition. Staging doesn't deduplicate, so the stg_orders unique test fails, the downstream mart tests are skipped, and fct_orders gets no rows for 10-01. No dbt model changed, and the schema matches the contract.

evidence.claim: Run 37ab043d failed at quality_checks; ingest and transform succeeded
raw.orders has 901 rows vs a median of 461; stg_orders has 461 duplicate order_ids; fct_orders has 0 rows for the day
The 461 extra rows are the full 2026-09-30 day sent again with identical values; no order_id repeats within the file
No dbt model changes; ingest config is default; schema matches the contract
For stale rows resent from a previous day, the runbook prescribes redelivery, not ingest dedupe
order_items and payments are within normal ranges

alternatives_considered: deduplicate_on_ingest(orders, order_id): rejected. The duplicates are across partitions, so deduplicating inside one partition does nothing, and the runbook explicitly rules it out for this case
duplicate_rows_in_file: ruled out. All 901 order_ids within the 10-01 partition are distinct
bad_model_deploy / revert_model_change: ruled out. No changed models
schema change: ruled out. The header matches the contract
escalate_to_owner(upstream_app_team): kept as the next step if the redelivered file still contains the 09-30 rows

proposal.rationale: The 2026-10-01 orders export has 901 rows. 440 are real 10-01 orders, and the other 461 are the whole 2026-09-30 day sent again, identical to what was already loaded under the 09-30 partition. No order_id repeats inside the file; every duplicate collides with an earlier partition. The runbook calls this Cause B (stale rows resent) and says to request redelivery, not deduplicate_on_ingest, because deduplicating within one partition cannot remove keys that collide with another partition. order_items and payments row counts are normal, and their checks pass. No dbt models changed, and the columns match the contract.
